name: Rajvir Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2004, Rajvir Industries Ltd manufactures various types of yarns and blends[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RIL is engaged in the manufacturing of cotton yarn, mélange, synthetics, modal, dyed products, compact yarn, flame-retardant, supima, silk, wool, cashmere and angora blend. The company has a range that covers everything from 100% cotton/ organic/ fair-trade /combed yarns, blended yarns (polyester, viscose, modal, spun silk, and flame-retardant), synthetic yarn, and mélange yarn

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -34.8% over past five years.
